episode_title: Episode 10: Winning the Client Is Just the Beginning

real_qa.q: Why did a professional services firm lose a client renewal despite delivering exactly what was requested?
real_qa.r: The firm delivered exactly what the client asked for, but they did not do more. Competing firms were proactively doing additional work, and the client expected more. The client said: 'We had firms calling us all the time, doing more. While your firm was doing the work, other firms were doing more. We expect more.'
real_qa.requete: professional services firm lose client renewal

real_qa.q: What are the seven above-and-beyond strategies to retain clients after winning a professional services engagement?
real_qa.r: The seven strategies are: (1) take quarterly business review meetings to align with client priorities; (2) introduce clients to interesting people and specialists; (3) show them new technology; (4) collaborate with clients on AI usage; (5) make investments in clients such as free or discounted time for projects; (6) meet other people at the client organization beyond your primary contact; (7) monitor market rates, margins, and efficiency to maintain competitive pricing.
real_qa.requete: seven strategies retain clients professional services

real_qa.q: What is the purpose of quarterly business review meetings between professional services providers and their clients?
real_qa.r: Quarterly business review meetings should discuss how the service provider is aligning with the client's stakeholder priorities—not corporate objectives. The meeting should address whether the provider is helping the stakeholder achieve their personal goals, and whether anything has changed for the individual or the company. This demonstrates the provider is doing more and creates stickiness.
real_qa.requete: quarterly business review meeting client priorities

real_qa.q: How should professional services providers approach using AI tools when serving clients?
real_qa.r: Rather than using AI without disclosure, collaborate with clients on AI usage. Tell them you used AI, show them how you used it, help them get smarter about AI usage, and ask for their input. Clients are smart and may have useful feedback. Collaboration is the key differentiator beyond core service delivery.

real_qa.q: What does 'investing in clients' mean for professional services engagement leaders?
real_qa.r: Investing in clients means providing free or discounted time for projects the client wants to pursue but hesitates due to budget, direction uncertainty, or bandwidth constraints. You might do a phase zero or straw man proposal to show you are investing your time in the relationship. The worst outcome is the client never calls again, but more likely the investment will pay dividends through future work.

real_quote: Winning the client is just the beginning. Delivering excellent service is just table stakes. Doing more is business development.
